en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a panoramic view of a European town nestled between green hills and mountains. A river runs through the town, crossed by a metal bridge in the foreground. The town is composed mainly of 19th and early 20th-century buildings, with a mix of residential and commercial architecture. The surrounding landscape suggests an alpine or pre-alpine setting.
